comment.narrative: The regulatory framework for an integrated system of public policy management does not exist as yet Mediumterm planning lacks a comprehensive approach and a clear alignment of mediumterm policy documents with fiscal strategy. Strategic and legal documents lack consistent and comprehensive regulatory impact assessments elaborated prior to their adoption Reporting is not in place for all mediumterm documents and where reports are published they lack information on achieved outcomes.
The Addendum No 1 dated 3 August 2018 extended by one year the targets and disbursements indicatively planned to be achieved by 31 December 2018 included in Annex IA

Delays experimented with the adoption of the Law on Planning System have postponed the timing of its enforcement. As a result the adoption of strategies and action plans by the government in 2017 was not subject to the regulations expected to be in place when the SRC target 2017 was defined. 2019 Target not met Score 0 Less than 49 of ministries midterm plans are compliant with the adopted bylaw containing mid term planning methodology.
